Record Class FinalScoreBreakdown

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
it.polimi.it.observer.FinalScoreBreakdown
Record Components:
playerName - player nickname
inGamePrestige - prestige points earned before end-game bonuses
builderPoints - end-game points from Builders
inventorPoints - end-game points from Inventors
artistPoints - end-game points from Artists
buildingPoints - points printed on acquired buildings
totalPrestige - final prestige total
food - food remaining at game end
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record FinalScoreBreakdown(String playerName, int inGamePrestige, int builderPoints, int inventorPoints, int artistPoints, int buildingPoints, int totalPrestige, int food) extends Record implements Serializable
Immutable explanation of one player's final score calculation.
